description: Crafted Datadog corpus for the incident question set (questions.json). Objects have the shape of Datadog API responses so the real adapters parse them. Services: checkout, checkout-worker (similar name), payments, auth-api, sökmotor; environments prod and staging. The questions are asked at 2026-03-12T09:00:00Z in Europe/Stockholm, so 'yesterday' is 2026-03-10T23:00:00Z..2026-03-11T23:00:00Z. The recorded fixtures' monitors, dashboards, SLOs and metrics are indexed alongside as unrelated distractors.

GatewayTimeoutException: bank gateway did not answer within 3000 ms. Återförsök 1 av 3 misslyckades (決済ゲートウェイ) – kortbetalning nekad för kund i Malmö 🚨. at payments.gateway.BankClient.authorize(BankClient.kt:212) at payments.api.CardController.pay(CardController.kt:88). Återförsök 2 av 3 misslyckades (決済ゲートウェイ) – kortbetalning nekad för kund i Tōkyō 🚨. at payments.gateway.BankClient.authorize(BankClient.kt:212) at payments.api.CardController.pay(CardController.kt:88). Återförsök 3 av 3 misslyckades (決済ゲートウェイ) – kortbetalning nekad för kund i Göteborg 🚨. at payments.gateway.BankClient.authorize(BankClient.kt:212) at payments.api.CardController.pay(CardController.kt:88). Connection pool state: 64/64 busy, 118 waiting. Circuit breaker for bank gateway opened after 25 consecutive failures; half-open probe scheduled in 30 s. Gateway response headers: x-request-id=7f3c2a91, server=bank-edge-eu-north-1, retry-after=none. Upstream TLS handshake took 2870 ms; DNS lookup 12 ms; connect 45 ms. Previous successful authorization 00:04:12 ago. Tidigare lyckade betalningar: 1 204 i senaste timmen, misslyckade: 377. ご注意: 決済ゲートウェイの応答が遅延しています。再試行ポリシー: 指数バックオフ (200 ms, 400 ms, 800 ms). Merchant accounts affected: se-retail-01, se-retail-02, jp-retail-07. Customer-facing error shown: "Betalningen kunde inte genomföras – försök igen om en stund." Trace ids: 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736, 00f067aa0ba902b7, 7a085853722dc6d2. Heap usage 71%; GC pauses p99 42 ms; thread pool payments-io 32/32 active. Bank gateway status page reported degraded performance in region eu-north-1 from 07:02. Rollback not applicable: no deploy in the last 24 hours. Next steps suggested by runbook RB-PAY-12: fail over to secondary acquirer, raise gateway timeout to 5000 ms temporarily, notify merchant success team. Återförsök mot sekundär inlösare lyckades för 83 % av de nekade betalningarna. 二次アクワイアラーへのフェイルオーバーは成功しました (83 %). End of incident log excerpt; see incident 46 for the full timeline. Additional context: the payments service depends on the bank gateway for card authorization, 3-D Secure challenges and refunds; refunds were queued and replayed after recovery. Queue depth peaked at 4 812 messages at 07:21; drained by 07:48. Alerting: monitor 1004 (Payments API 5xx rate) and monitor 1005 (Betalningar: timeout mot bankgateway) both triggered at 07:04 and recovered at 07:52. SLO burn: payments latency SLO consumed 38 % of its monthly error budget during the event. Owner: team payments (on-call: Åsa Öberg 👩‍💻). Postmortem scheduled. Åtgärdspunkter: 1) lägg till timeout-larm på TLS-handskakning, 2) automatisera failover till sekundär inlösare, 3) följ upp med banken om kapacitet i eu-north-1.
